definitions.gloss: dark soy sauce; standard Japanese soy sauce
definitions.explanation: The dark, full-flavored type of soy sauce, which accounts for over 80% of soy sauce consumed in Japan. The default when a recipe simply calls for しょうゆ.

examples.japanese: {濃口|こいくち}{醤油|しょうゆ}を{使|つか}う。
{関東|かんとう}では{濃口|こいくち}が{一般的|いっぱんてき}だ。
examples.english: Dark soy sauce is standard in the Kanto region.

examples.japanese: {煮物|にもの}には{濃口|こいくち}{醤油|しょうゆ}の{方|ほう}が{色|いろ}も{味|あじ}もよく{出|で}る。
examples.english: For simmered dishes, dark soy sauce brings out better color and flavor.

notes:
Compound of {濃|こ}い (strong, thick) + {口|くち} (mouth, flavor). Almost always used in the fixed expression {濃口|こいくち}{醤油|しょうゆ}, referring to the most common type of Japanese soy sauce. Predominant in eastern Japan ({関東|かんとう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濃口|こいくち}{醤油|しょうゆ}: dark soy sauce
- {濃口|こいくち}を{使|つか}う: to use dark soy sauce
- {濃口|こいくち}{仕立|した}て: prepared with dark soy sauce

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {薄口|うすくち}: light soy sauce — lighter in color but actually saltier; common in {関西|かんさい}
- たまり{醤油|じょうゆ}: tamari soy sauce — thicker, wheat-free or low-wheat
- {白醤油|しろじょうゆ}: white soy sauce — very pale, mild flavor
